candidate_origins.todo_line: - [ ] 001 Create the repository migration matrix for every club-member LiveView, recording projection-backed reads, query/result boundaries, existing refresh predicates, fresh authorization and access transitions, event-to-interest mappings (including collection entry/exit, old/new scopes and conservative fallbacks), transient-state exceptions, focused proof and gaps; explicitly inventory the deferred staff streams and other out-of-scope surfaces.

completion_evidence_required: Report the revised migration-matrix path and summarize each of the five review gaps closed.
Quote or precisely summarize the new MembaStaffEmailDelivery mapping, including exact-scope derivation, conservative fallback, independent commit behavior, and affected query/proof rows.

Explain how represented-member role-label interests and badge-refresh proof now differ from current-actor permission invalidation, and how compatibility membership removals differ from exact role removals.
Confirm the corrected old-scope semantics for access grants and root-time ordering semantics for dashboard conversations.
Provide the focused validation commands with exit statuses and report `git status --short`, confirming the revision remained documentation-only and did not run the full quality gate.
constraints: Keep the revision descriptive and evidence-backed, clearly separating current repository behavior, required future migration, existing proof, and remaining proof.
Use `docs/iterations/067-live-projection-queries/migration-matrix.md` as the sole substantive changed path for this task.
Describe both delivery projectors as independently committed contributors; do not imply that observing one guarantees the joined result already contains the other's commit.
For missing message scope, prefer deriving it from committed changes or the delivery row and then document broad delivery-family fallback if it remains unavailable.
Do not invent `role_id` for membership-removal events or treat all Role-projector events as exact person/role changes.
Preserve the approved one coherent dashboard result and exact conversation/delivery query boundaries.
Retain the distinction between initial-render badge evidence and missing open-view badge-refresh proof.
This remains a docs-only revision, so do not run `dev check`, `dev check --quick`, `dev ci`, or another full-suite command.
focused_validation: Verify the projector mapping explicitly distinguishes `MemberEmailDelivery` from `MembaStaffEmailDelivery`, documents independently committed convergence and missing-message-scope fallback, and assigns the dependency to conversation and delivery detail as applicable.

Verify the Role mapping separately describes exact role assignment/removal and membership-removal compatibility events, and that dashboard interests plus proof gaps mention represented-member role labels and live badge refresh.

Verify the ConversationAccessGrantedToGroup old scope allows an existing grant with an unavailable prior level, and verify the Message mapping says replies update derived overview data without reordering root-time-ordered dashboard rows.

Inspect `git diff -- docs/iterations/067-live-projection-queries/migration-matrix.md` and `git status --short`; confirm no application, test, feature, ADR, plan, todo, reference, schema, or unrelated documentation file changed.
outcome: Revise `docs/iterations/067-live-projection-queries/migration-matrix.md` so its projector and proof inventory accurately covers every projection contributing to dashboard and message-detail results and closes all five source-backed gaps from the latest review without changing the approved contract or implementation.

references.facts: The approved inventory must cover every contributing projector, collection and identity interests, old/new scope or conservative fallback, fresh authorization, and focused proof gaps before the dashboard and conversation-detail contract is frozen.

The candidate already inventories seven member LiveViews and excluded surfaces, but its current mapping omits MembaStaffEmailDelivery, treats dashboard Role interests only as current-person permission concerns, says grants have no old access row, conflates exact role removals with membership-removal compatibility, and says replies can reorder dashboard conversations.

The latest review requires revision for five specific gaps: MembaStaffEmailDelivery and independent-commit convergence, represented-member role labels and badge proof, grant old scope, role-removal versus membership-removal scope, and root-time dashboard ordering.

The prior worker changed only the migration matrix, reported docs-only focused validations as passing, and identified no unresolved issue; preserve that candidate and make a narrow corrective revision.

Every projector publishes its own post-commit notification from `after_update/3`; independently committed projections that contribute to one query result must each invalidate it so later commits converge.
A live query must account for every contributing projection and refresh by authorized reread; the migration matrix remains evidence for that boundary rather than a concrete package API.

This projector independently inserts and updates detailed delivery rows, including delayed, bounced, and complaint reasons, and publishes its own committed read-model notification. Status events identify `delivery_id` but do not carry `message_id`.

This separate projector independently inserts and updates member-facing simplified statuses and publishes after commit. Its status-event handlers also start from `delivery_id`, so exact message scope may need committed changes or a lookup.

`list_member_email_deliverys/1` reads MemberEmailDelivery rows and left-joins MembaStaffEmailDelivery by delivery ID to merge `reason`. Dashboard conversation queries are explicitly ordered by original root insertion time, so newer replies update derived overview fields without reordering roots.

The shared detail loader calls `Messaging.list_member_email_deliverys/1` and presents receipts, summaries, groups, and counts; both conversation and delivery LiveViews therefore consume the staff-projection reason join when they use this model.

Exact assignment/removal handlers update one membership/role pair, while ClubMemberRemoved and legacy MemberRemoved compatibility handlers deactivate every assignment and delete permissions for the membership. Role definitions and permissions can also affect represented labels or authorization at broader scope.
ClubMemberRemoved carries club, membership, and person IDs but no role ID, so the Role projector compatibility update cannot be represented as one exact role removal.
Legacy MemberRemoved requires only membership ID; club and person may be absent, requiring a broader fallback if committed changes do not supply scope.

Dashboard member rows preserve each represented member's `roles`, while conversation rows expose reply count, latest replier, and participants using the root's insertion time as `sent_at`; these are query-result dependencies that the matrix must map accurately.

Existing tests prove initial role-badge rendering and synthetic current-actor role-loss behavior, but they do not prove an already-open dashboard refreshes represented members' badges after role projection changes; record that as a remaining gap.

ConversationAccessGrantedToGroup uses an upsert on conversation/group and can replace an existing access level. The event carries the new level but not the old one, so the old relationship may exist even though its prior level is unavailable.
MessageSent inserts roots and replies with exact or derivable conversation identity; it does not itself establish dashboard ordering semantics, which come from the root-conversation query.

scope: Add `Memba.Messaging.Projectors.MembaStaffEmailDelivery` to the projector/event mapping because its independently committed rows supply the delivery `reason` joined into `Messaging.list_member_email_deliverys/1`; record exact delivery/message interests where derivable, the fallback when status events or committed changes do not reveal message scope, and the need for both member and staff delivery notifications to converge the result regardless of commit order.

Update the conversation-detail and delivery-detail query coverage and remaining-proof entries as applicable so they explicitly include MembaStaffEmailDelivery reason changes and independently committed MemberEmailDelivery/MembaStaffEmailDelivery convergence, while retaining exact-message isolation.

Record that represented dashboard members' role labels and badges are projection-backed result dependencies, not only the current member's permissions. Extend the Role mapping, dashboard query interests, and remaining proof to cover live represented-member role assignment/removal or role-label changes and badge refresh; distinguish this from manage-members authorization proof.

Correct the ConversationAccessGrantedToGroup old-scope description: the upsert may replace an existing lower-level grant for the same conversation/group, so the prior relationship can already exist and its old access level is not carried by the event.

Separate exact role assignment/removal events, which carry `role_id`, from Role-projector membership-removal compatibility events. Document that `ClubMemberRemoved` lacks `role_id`, legacy `MemberRemoved` may lack club/person scope, and those events remove all assignments/permissions for a membership and therefore require membership/person or conservative club/global role invalidation rather than a fabricated exact role identity.

Correct the Message mapping to state that a new root can enter the dashboard's root-time-ordered conversation collection, while replies update derived reply count, latest replier, participant, and conversation-detail data without reordering dashboard rows by reply time.

Preserve the matrix's route inventory, fresh-authorization rules, transient-state exclusions, deferred staff-stream inventory, existing proof distinctions, and task-003 handoff constraints except where a review correction requires a precise addition.
scope_exclusions: Do not edit `todo.md`, `plan.md`, ADRs, reference docs, application code, tests, acceptance feature files, schemas, or delivery artifacts as implementation work.
Do not implement the generic package, Memba adapter, query modules, subscriptions, migrations, or tests in this revision.
Do not freeze concrete interest types, package API names, module placement, or reconnect hooks.
Do not broaden task-001 into task-003 contract implementation or task-008 acceptance and full-gate work.
Do not mark the todo line accepted or describe missing future proof as completed.
Do not restructure unrelated correct portions of the migration matrix.
